info.title: Radius_Dynamic_Authorization_Client
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address.description:
Reference Resource: [Radius_Dynamic_Authorization_Client](#/Radius_Dynamic_Authorization_Client)
IPV4/IPV6 address or FQDN of the RADIUS DAC.

connection_type.description:
Reference Resource: [Radius_Dynamic_Authorization_Client](#/Radius_Dynamic_Authorization_Client)
Specify the connection_type of RADIUS DAC.

replay_protection_enable.description: Enables replay protection for the client.

resolved_ip_addr.description: IP address resolved for this Dynamic Authorization Client. It can be IPv4 or IPv6. This is only set if the configured RADIUS Dynauth Client is in FQDN format.

rfc5176_enforcement_mode.description: Enforcement mode of RFC5176. 'strict': authorization attributes are not allowed as part of           disconnect requests. 'loose' : authorization attributes are allowed as part of           disconnect requests.

secret_key.description: The secret key used to communicate with this RADIUS DAC. If not set, then all requests from DAC will be silently discarded.

statistics.description: Contains key-value pairs that report the number of RADIUS dynamic authorization (CoA or disconnect) packets communicated with the DAC. This statistics will be updated every 5 seconds.

coa_ack.description: Number of RADIUS CoA-ACKs sent towards this DAC.

coa_authorize_only_reqs.description: Number of RADIUS CoA-requests received from this DAC with service-type attribute set to 'Authorize only'.

coa_malformed_reqs.description: Number of malformed RADIUS CoA-Requests received from this DAC (exluding the one's with bad authenticators and unknown types).

coa_nak.description: Number of RADIUS CoA-NAK's sent towards this DAC including the one's with Service-Type attribute set to 'Authorize Only' and also because of non established session context.

coa_nak_session_no_context.description: Number of RADIUS CoA-NAKs sent towards this DAC because no session context was found.

coa_nak_user_session_changed.description: Number of user session's authorization changed due to RADIUS CoA-Requests received from this DAC.

coa_packets_dropped.description: Number of incoming RADIUS CoA packets discarded silently from this DAC for the reasons other than malforming, bad authenticators or unknown types.

coa_reqs.description: Number of RADIUS CoA-requests received from this DAC.

coa_reqs_bad_authenticators.description: Number of RADIUS CoA-Requests received with bad authenticator from this DAC.

disc_ack.description: Number of RADIUS Disconnect-ACKs sent to this DAC.

disc_nak.description: Number of RADIUS Disconnect-NAKs sent to this DAC.

disc_nak_no_session_context.description: Number of RADIUS Disconnect-NAKs sent towards this DAC due to non existing session context.

disc_reqs.description: Number of RADIUS Disconnect-Requests received from this DAC.

disc_reqs_authorize_only.description: Number of RADIUS Disconnect-Requests recevied from this DAC with service-type attribute set to 'Authorize only'.

disc_reqs_bad_auth.description: Number of RADIUS Disconnect-Requests received from this DAC with invalid authenticator field.

disc_reqs_dropped.description: Number of incoming RADIUS Disconnect-Requests from this DAC silently discarded due to the reasons other than malformed, bad authenticators or unknown types.

disc_reqs_malformed.description: Number of malformed RADIUS Disconnect-Requests received from this DAC (excluding the one's with bad authenticators and unknown types).

disc_user_session_removed.description: Number of user sessions removed honouring the RADIUS Disconnect-Request received from this DAC.

unknown_types.description: The number of RADIUS packets with unknown type received from this DAC.

time_window.description: Time Window (in secs) within which RADIUS packets carrying the  'Event-Timestamp' attribute will be considered as current and  accepted for processing by the NAS.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [Radius_Dynamic_Authorization_Client](#/Radius_Dynamic_Authorization_Client)
VRF of the RADIUS Dynamic Authorization Client(DAC).

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
